name: Division by zero
description: Flags divisions by zero where they are likely to happen.
definition: Flags, as a `[warning]`, a `/` or `%` whose right-hand operand is a compile-time-constant zero (e.g. `x / 0`, `x % 0.0`, `x / (1 - 1)`, `x / (0 / 1)`, `x / (values.Length - values.Length)`), since that crashes the script at runtime. A divisor built from literals (combined with arithmetic, comparison, logical, and unary operators) is checked, as is `x - x` when both sides are the same side-effect-free expression (an identifier, `Self`/`Parent`, a member/index access, or a cast). A divisor that depends on a call or a `new` array/struct is left unflagged rather than guessed at.
